|game_text=Deploy on table. Each Amidala stacked on a Political Effect is a senator. While you have < 13 cards in hand, opponent may not peek at or remove them (except with [[Grimtaash]]). Once per turn, may ▲ [Virtual] [[Astromech Shortage (V){{!}}Astromech Shortage]] or lose 2 Force to cancel a Political Effect. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
|errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The image here is the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-40-Tarkins_Bounty.png]]). The same words were published again on the Players Committee card image and in the Virtual Cards Master List of 2013; the current text is [[Tarkin's Bounty (V) (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 3)]] (Master List, PC-E3).
* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, official text as of 4 September 2009, and the Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (slip 40)<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref><ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1-revised">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=6 Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet], revised copy (PDF dated by 20 April 2010), page 6, slip 40. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=6 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table. Each Amidala stacked on a Political Effect is a senator. While you have < 13 cards in hand, opponent may not peek at or remove them (except with Grimtaash). Once per turn, may ▲ [Virtual] Astromech Shortage or lose 2 Force to cancel a Political Effect. (Immune to Alter.)” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-40-Tarkins_Bounty.png]]) prints it. The slip prints slip number 40 at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Tarkin's Bounty (V) (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 6 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1261_40">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock6Type (Virtual Block 6 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “Deploy on table. Each Amidala stacked on a Political Effect is a senator. While you have < 13 cards in hand, opponent may not peek at or remove them (except with Grimtaash). Once per turn, may ▲ one [Virtual] Astromech Shortage, or lose 2 Force to cancel a Political Effect. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' Two changes: “one” is added before the card name, and a comma is added after “Astromech Shortage”. The Players Committee generated the website card list from its Holotable card data, so this wording is that data's transcription of the card; the Players Committee published it on its own website, so it is a version. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes; the text here draws the icons as the printed slips do. The list shows no slip image.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Tarkin's Bounty (V) (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-tarkinsbounty-pre.gif]]), on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013<ref name="pc-img-date-Virtual6-Dark">Players Committee card image folder (<code>Virtual6-Dark/large/</code>), web-server directory listing sorted by date: every file last modified 25 February 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034706/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.</ref>: “Deploy on table. Each Amidala stacked on a Political Effect is a senator. While you have < 13 cards in hand, opponent may not peek at or remove them (except with Grimtaash). Once per turn, may ▲ [Virtual] Astromech Shortage or lose 2 Force to cancel a Political Effect. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word, undoing the card-list changes listed under PC-E1. The date is the bulk upload date of the whole image folder, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is a version at its upload date, and what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It prints the same slip number as the release-sheet slip (40).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Tarkin's Bounty (V) (Virtual Block 6) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 31)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=31 Internet Archive]</ref>, slip [[:File:VL-history-1261-40-front-master.png]]: “Deploy on table. Each Amidala stacked on a Political Effect is a senator. While you have < 13 cards in hand, opponent may not peek at or remove them (except with Grimtaash). Once per turn, may ▲ [Virtual] Astromech Shortage or lose 2 Force to cancel a Political Effect. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word (the same words as the PC card image, PC-E2). The Master List slip prints no slip number. Every published text is a version, even a word-for-word repeat (versions ruling of 11 November 2026).
